title: Joe Concha slams Jill Biden for calling Joe Biden 'heroic'
text:
Washington Examiner columnist Joe Concha slammed former first lady Jill Biden for calling her husband, former President Joe Biden, “heroic” for dropping out of the 2024 presidential election.

“That was not heroic; it was cowardly. I mean, let’s face it, Joe Biden got bullied out of running for reelection,” Concha said on Fox News’s Saturday in America.
